create_captured_stdout_buffer: create a CapturedStdout instance with a StringIO buffer to capture and retrieve stdout output incrementally
use_teeing_stream_proxy: use TeeingStreamProxy to wrap stdout or stderr and duplicate all written data to an output buffer
run_tee_output_python: run tee_output_python context manager to duplicate sys.stdout and sys.stderr to a StringIO buffer
run_tee_output_fd: run tee_output_fd context manager to duplicate stdout and stderr to a temporary file at the file descriptor level
get_stdcapturer_by_mode: get a std capturer context manager by mode name such as no, fd, or sys
